# `candid gmail`

Gmail Takeout mbox import: parse, propose, confirm.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid gmail [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `import` | Import a Google Takeout .mbox file (or directory of them). |
| `proposals` | List pending Gmail proposals. |
| `confirm` | Confirm a proposal -> writes to the tracker. |
| `reject` | Dismiss a proposal. |
| `guide` | How to export Gmail via Google Takeout. |


### `candid gmail import`

Import a Google Takeout .mbox file (or directory of them).

```
usage: python -m candid gmail import [-h] [--max MAX] file
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `file` | Path to the .mbox file or a directory of .mbox files (required) |
| `--max` `MAX` | Max messages to read (0 = all) |


### `candid gmail proposals`

List pending Gmail proposals.

```
usage: python -m candid gmail proposals [-h]
```

### `candid gmail confirm`

Confirm a proposal -> writes to the tracker.

```
usage: python -m candid gmail confirm [-h] id
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | (required) |


### `candid gmail reject`

Dismiss a proposal.

```
usage: python -m candid gmail reject [-h] id
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | (required) |


### `candid gmail guide`

How to export Gmail via Google Takeout.

```
usage: python -m candid gmail guide [-h]
```
